snippet.title: The Shadow Over Cyberspace - Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story.

A new visual novel from Fiction Factory Games, creators of Arcade Spirits and Penny Larceny. Coming January 10, 2024 to Windows, Mac, and Linux for FREE thanks to our supportive community.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2982530/The_Shadow_Over_Cyberspace/

Follow our socials for updates: https://www.fictionfactorygames.com
